crossRefs.note: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will be devoted to one…
When Joshua was by Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, a man stood in front of him with his sword…
If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served…
David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united…
Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you…
For whoever is not against us is on our side.
Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”
“He that is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.
What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?
What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will…
They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us.…
“I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.
The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs.…
The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head…
and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered…
